evidence.rep: **rep 80（極困難）**——10-K FY2025: 『We have more than 23,500 active patents in the United States and other countries, and additional applications are pending for new inventions.』（Patents and Licenses）／『Our ability to compete requires a high level of investment in RD&E, marketing and sales, and global customer support activities.』（Competition）／『Customer demand is fulfilled through a global distribution system and trained field engineers located near customer sites to support our semiconductor and other equipment worldwide.』（AGS）／『Incorporated in 1967, we are a Delaware corporation.』。R&D は FY2025 3,570百万$（売上28,368の12.6%）、FY2016–FY2025 の10年累計 24,792百万$（SEC XBRL ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense）＝数十年・百億ドル級の蓄積。**100 にしない理由**（同じ原本の反証）: 『Substantial competition exists across all the segments of our business.』（Competition）＝全セグメントに競合が実在し、『We could see increased competition from domestic equipment manufacturers in China resulting from local government incentives and funding as well as export controls established by the United States government to restrict the sale of certain technologies to customers in China.』＝政府資金による追随が進行中、さらに 『Infringement or misappropriation of our intellectual property rights, such as the manufacture or sale of equipment or spare parts that use our technology without authorization, could result in uncompensated lost market and revenue opportunities.』（Item 1A）。→ 複製不能とは言えず、数年で追随できるものでもない＝80。旧60の根拠は原本に無い競合の社名に依っていた（10-K は競合を一社も名指ししない）

evidence.erosion: **emerging**——10-K FY2025 Item 1A 『Over the past several years, the U.S. government announced additional export regulations for U.S. semiconductor technology sold in China, including wafer fabrication equipment and related parts and services, with disparate impact on companies in different jurisdictions, which have limited the market for certain of our products and services, adversely impacted our revenues and increased our exposure to foreign and Chinese domestic competition.』（実現済みの記述・10-Q Part II Item 1A に同文）＋ 『We could see increased competition from domestic equipment manufacturers in China resulting from local government incentives and funding as well as export controls established by the United States government to restrict the sale of certain technologies to customers in China.』（Item 1 Competition）＋ 『Our inability to obtain such licenses could limit our sales in China, may cause us to be displaced by foreign and Chinese domestic companies and adversely affect our results of operations.』。中国の売上比率は FY2024 37% → FY2025 30% → 10-Q 9か月 28%。active にしない理由: 侵食が業績の数字に出ていない——売上総利益率 FY2024 47.5% → FY2025 48.7% → 10-Q 9か月 49.8%、Semiconductor Systems の営業利益率 35.1% → 35.5%（10-K Note 15）。旧 none は hits の蝕セクションにヒットが無いことだけが根拠だった
